name: Dito Product Showcase
author: OSMAR GS JUNIOR PLUGINS

sections.description:
Dito Product Showcase helps site owners publish a simple product showcase without needing a full ecommerce setup.

You can add products, images, categories, SKU or code information, optional prices, and display the showcase on any page using a shortcode.

Features:

  • Product custom post type.
  • Product categories.
  • Product image, description, SKU/code, and optional price.
  • Contact button using the number configured in the plugin settings.
  • Shortcode for full or category-based product showcases.
  • Basic Portuguese and English admin labels.

Shortcode examples:

[dito_product_showcase]

[dito_product_showcase categoria="category-slug" quantidade="12"]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dito-product-showcase directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Dito Showcase in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Add products and configure the contact number.
  5. Add the shortcode to a page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin process payments?

No. It only displays products and creates a contact link.

Does this plugin require another ecommerce plugin?

No. It uses its own lightweight product post type.

Does this plugin require a license key?

No. This WordPress.org version does not require any license key.
